summary: This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K by Studio City International Holdings Limited, reporting unaudited Q1 2026 results. It contains no transaction, no material definitive agreement, and no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing merely presents operational and financial metrics including revenues, gaming volumes, and adjusted EBITDA. There are no deal terms, no board recommendations, and no structural changes. The filing is a standard periodic report and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
